title: fix(service-analytics): a lookup dataset dimension serves the referenced record's name for a relationship path and for a target titled by its nameField
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #33107

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据集的查找(lookup)维度现在在两种情况下显示被引用记录的名称,而不是 id:一是关系路径维度(如 `account.owner_id`,显示负责人的名字);二是目标对象以 `nameField` 作标题(如自动编号的订单号 `SO-2026-0002`)。排序也按显示的名称排。
- 为什么改:下游应用在 18.3.0 上的仪表盘这两种维度都显示原始 id,它的卡因此被挡住(#33107,p1)。路径维度以前只在基础对象的字段表里找字段;标签读取以前从不看目标对象声明的 `nameField`。
- 风险与回滚:patch 级,只改 `service-analytics` 的标签读取,不改查询、分组和规格(Clause-② no,元数据协议不变)。分组仍按 id,两个同名的人仍是两行;API 不暴露的目标、行级权限隐藏的记录仍显示 id。注册表会给每个自有对象指定 `nameField`,所以标题字段与旧规则不同的目标,现在显示的是平台其他地方显示的那个标题。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dimension-labels.ts`(`dimensionColumn` 与 `pickDisplayField`)、`analytics-service.ts` 里 `columnObjectOfField`(复用查询本身用的 `columnObjectOf`)、`plugin.ts` 的 `fetchRecordLabels`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics-dataset-lookup-dimension-labels.test.ts`,预期 6 个全部通过(REST、`query_dataset` 工具、直接调用三个入口给出同样带名称的行)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**A, relationship-path lookups.** `resolveDimensionLabels` and the sort-key resolver (`createOrderLabelResolver`) looked a dimension's `field` up on the base object's field map only. A path such as `account.owner_id` found no field meta there, so its FK id was served. Each dimension the service hands to the label passes now carries `columnObject`, the object the path's column lives on, and both passes read the column's meta (`owner_id`) on that object.

- `columnObject` comes from `columnObjectOf` (`hop-object.ts`), over the compiled dataset cube's joins and the service's `hopReference`. That is the one hop resolver the query's joins, the field gate and the read scope already use, so the object labelled is the object the query read. The label module walks no path of its own.
- A `select` column at the end of a path now serves its option label, translated under that object and column (`translateSelectOptions(columnObject, column, …)`).
- A dimension without `columnObject` reads `field` verbatim on the base object, as before.

**B, targets titled by `nameField`.** `pickDisplayField(fields, nameField?)` returns the target's declared `nameField` first, when the field map declares it and it is not virtual (the spec's `isVirtualSearchField`, i.e. not a `formula`). Otherwise it falls back to the old order: `name`, `title`, `label`, then the first text field. `plugin.ts` `fetchRecordLabels` passes the target schema's `nameField`. Before this, a target titled by an `autonumber` with no `name`/`title`/`label` field was read through its first text field, the platform-injected ownership `queue`, which is null on every row. No label came back and the id was served.

**Callers of `pickDisplayField`.** There is one production caller, `plugin.ts` `fetchRecordLabels`, and it now passes `nameField`. The other references are the package export (`index.ts`, where the added parameter is optional) and the tests in `dimension-labels.test.ts` and `dataset-reference-dimension-labels.test.ts`, which call it without `nameField` and keep their answers. Nothing outside `service-analytics` imports it (repo-wide grep over `packages/` and `ui/`).

**MCP `query_dataset`.** It does not have a label path of its own. The MCP tool (`mcp-http-tools.ts`) calls the runtime bridge (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `service.datasetTools(…).queryDataset`), which calls `AnalyticsService.queryDataset`, which runs this label pass. The new integration test pins that the `query_dataset` executor serves the same labelled rows as the REST door. `packages/mcp` is not touched.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-lookup-dimension-labels.test.ts` (new) runs on a real `ObjectQL` engine over SQLite, with the analytics service `AnalyticsServicePlugin` registers and its real `fetchRecordLabels` bridge. Every case asserts that three faces return equal rows: `POST /analytics/dataset/query` with `datasetName`, the `query_dataset` tool executor, and the direct `queryDataset` call. The cases:
  - A: `account.owner_id` is labelled with the rep's name. Two reps who share the name "Sam Lee" stay two rows, because grouping is by id.
  - A: `order` asc on that dimension sorts by name, and `limit: 1` takes its window over that order. The ids sort the opposite way.
  - A: the card's second path, `cb_order.carbon_grade`, is labelled with the grade name.
  - A, gated: `account.region`, whose label target declares `enable.apiEnabled: false`, still renders the stored id.
  - B: a lookup to an `autonumber` `nameField` target, with the injected `queue` field ahead of it, is labelled with the order number.
  - CONTROL: a lookup to an object whose title is its `name` field labels as before.
- `dimension-labels.test.ts`, in its existing `pickDisplayField` describe: `nameField` comes before the convention, the CONTROL cases (`nameField: 'name'`, absent, empty) pick as before, and a `nameField` missing from the map or naming a `formula` falls through. A new top-level describe covers relationship-path dimensions: a user column on the hop object, a select column translated under the hop object, an unresolved path that stays raw, and the sort-key pass on the same column.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `nameField` reach is wider than the card's shape.** `SchemaRegistry` designates `nameField` on every owned object that has a title-eligible field (ADR-0079, `provisionPrimary` with `synthesize: false`). So the label read now follows each target's designated title, not only an explicit autonumber one. Where the old rule and the designated title already agree (an object with a text `name` field), nothing changes. Where they differ, for example an object whose title is `subject` or `full_name`, the dashboard now shows the title the rest of the platform shows for that record.
- **Formula titles are still skipped.** A text-formula `nameField` has no column the label read (an aggregate grouped by `id` and the display field) can group by, so the label is read from the old convention, as before. Serving a formula title on this read would be its own change.
- **`displayNameField`** (the deprecated alias) is not read here. Schema parse copies it onto `nameField`, and the registry reads the parsed schema.
- **A relationship field named `order` breaks the query.** While building the fixture, a dataset with `include: ['order']` and a dimension on that field answered `500 DATABASE_ERROR` on the REST door (SQLite: `near "order": syntax error`), at `origin/main` and with this change alike. The fixture uses `cb_order`, as the card does. This is reported to the seat to file. Dedupe words: dataset include reserved word, relationship alias unquoted, near order syntax error.
- **The integration test lives in `packages/rest`.** That package hosts the `POST /analytics/dataset/query` route, and its tests already build the real engine and plugin rig this test copies (`analytics-dataset-ai-tools-parity.test.ts`).

## Verification

On head `99fa452b` unless stated. Head `99fa452b` differs from `026cdd93` only in a type annotation in `dimension-labels.test.ts`.

<details><summary>Measurement at origin/main 7c36f524 (the new integration test, before the fix)</summary>

4 failed, 2 passed. Each face returned the same rows, and the rows carried ids:

- `rep`: `rep_a`, `rep_b`, `rep_c` (expected the names);
- the sort: `rep_a`, `rep_b`, `rep_c` (expected `Sam Lee`, `Sam Lee`, `Zed Young`);
- `grade`: `gr_330`, `gr_550` (expected `N330`, `N550`);
- `order`: `ord_1`, `ord_2` (expected `SO-2026-0001`, `SO-2026-0002`).

The two that passed are the gated region case and the CONTROL.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; service-analytics rebuilt each leg, marker proved in dist/ with ablation-dist-preflight.mjs, restored with the blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty and the marker proved absent)</summary>

- A, `dimensionColumn` forced to ignore `columnObject`: the rest test has 3 red (rep label, sort, grade) and 3 green (region, B, CONTROL). The unit files have 3 red (the path describe's user, select and sort-key cases).
- B, the `nameField` branch disabled: 1 red in rest (the order number) and 1 red in the unit tests (nameField before the convention).
- Exposure gate, `withServedLabelTargets` made to serve every target: 1 red in rest (the region path renders `East`) and 9 red in `dimension-label-exposure.test.ts`.
- Grouping by id, with the forbidden behaviour put back (the display pass merges rows that render the same label): 2 red in rest (rep label and sort, one "Sam Lee" row lost) and 1 red in the unit tests.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites, typecheck, lint, gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test`: 215 files, 5192 passed and 332 skipped (`026cdd93`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: 409 files, 8330 passed and 332 skipped (`026cdd93`).
- `typecheck`, which includes the test files: service-analytics exit 0 on `99fa452b`; rest exit 0 on `026cdd93`.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0 (`026cdd93`).
- Full declaration build (`turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'`, no `OS_SKIP_DTS`): exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 72 gates. On `026cdd93`, 71 exited 0. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exited 3 there because the shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit; after fetching `621a4876` it exited 0. All 72 were rerun on `99fa452b`, every one exit 0, and `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` (with an exit code on every line) reports: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. ESLint on the file changed after the `pnpm lint` run: exit 0.
</details>
